 Our November Pixel Drop is here, with new and expanded features making your Pixel devices more personalized, intuitive, and handy. See how we’re bringing smarter automation, next-level personalization, and upgraded connectivity to your favorite devices. Updates start rolling out today and will continue over the next several weeks.
 Use Pixel 10 with Gemini Intelligence
 Gemini Intelligence is now available on Pixel 10 devices , bringing new capabilities like Rambler, personalized suggestions, and taking care of multi-step tasks — like placing your morning coffee order.
 Polish your messages with Rambler on Pixel 10: Voice typing just got a major upgrade. Rambler can automatically remove filler words like “um,” and format your thoughts into clear, polished text. Just speak naturally, review, and send.
 Complete multi-step tasks with Gemini: Whether you’re getting groceries, booking a ride, ordering takeout, or trying to find a reservation at your favorite restaurant, let Gemini handle the logistics so you can focus on other tasks. Now available in Japan, UK, and India.
 Receive proactive suggestions: From sharing your ETA with a tap when someone asks when you’ll arrive, to helping you find the perfect dinner spot, your Pixel anticipates what you need with timely information and suggested actions, so you can accomplish your daily tasks faster.
 1 
 Also, coming soon to Pixel Watch 4.
 Create more personalized widgets: Ever find yourself wanting a widget that doesn’t seem to exist? Create personalized widgets, like a tracker to follow your monthly spending, a game day widget with your team colors, or a getaway countdown that automatically pulls in flight and reservation details. Your home screen can be as personalized as you want it to be. Also, coming soon to Pixel Watch 4 and Pixel Watch 5.
 2 
 Catch up on long conversations: Your Pixel can now provide summaries of your longer conversations, so you can see what’s important right away. Now available in German, French, Spanish, Italian, Hindi, and Traditional Chinese. Coming to Pixel Watches soon. 
 3 
 Call Screen got an upgrade on Pixel 11 series
 Whenever you see a call from an unknown number and choose to screen it, Gemini will ask unknown callers why they're reaching out in a much more conversational manner handling the exchange until you decide to jump in or end the call. With a live transcript displayed right on your screen, you can easily follow along and decide exactly when to pick up. Also, coming to Pixel Watch 4 and Pixel Watch 5 soon.
 4 
 Personalize your Pixel with new custom icon styles
 Following the launch of Custom Icons earlier this year, we’re adding more styles to give you even more ways to personalize your home screen Pixel. Pick from distinct styles that apply across all your app icons on the home screen.
 5 
 New updates coming to Pixel search
 Now available on Pixel 6 and newer devices, Pixel search helps you find what you need across your phone – from vacation photos and recent emails to messages, calendar events, and device settings.
 6 
 Stay in the moment with Google Messages and HiLight
 HiLight now supports Google Messages. When your phone is face down, HiLight will glow if you receive a message from one of your favorite contacts — letting you stay present without missing important messages or calls.
 7 
 Keep tabs on your belongings with Pixel Tag
 Pixel Tag offers peace of mind so you always know where your most important things are — and it’s available November 11. It’s slim enough to fit in your wallet and durable enough to attach to your belongings, with a battery that lasts over a year. The Find Hub network of more than 1 billion Android devices helps you locate your belongings even if they are miles away and UWB enables visual direction and distance guidance to find it nearby.
 8 
 Pixel Tag is available starting November 11 for $29.99 for one or $99.99 for a four-pack.
 Switch between two of America's best 5G networks with Google Fi
 Starting today on eligible Pixels, Google Fi’s new super network delivers the nation's fastest, most expansive coverage by automatically switching between two of America's top 5G cellular networks and millions of secure Wi-Fi networks.
 9 
 10 
 11 
 12 
Already have a Pixel but not using Google Fi? Get 50% off on select unlimited plans for 12 months. Ends 12/1/26. All terms apply. Visit the blog post , Google Fi website for details, and join Google Fi today .
 Related Article
 Google Fi’s new super network
 Google Fi Wireless is launching a new super network, combining two 5G networks with millions of Wi-Fi networks in one phone plan. 
 See more
 Unlock your Pixel Watch with your phone
 Your Pixel devices work better together. When your watch is on your wrist and you’ve unlocked your nearby phone, your Pixel Watch will automatically unlock so you can skip typing your PIN or pattern on the watch. Coming in the next few weeks.
 13 
 Step-by-step workouts are rolling out to Pixel Watch
 We’re now rolling out step-by-step workouts to Pixel Watch 3 and newer models. Whether you’re following an exercise routine created by your Google Health Coach
 14 
 or a custom workout built in the Google Health app, you can get step-by-step instructions, log reps and weights, and track metrics directly from your Pixel Watch or your phone.
 Check out our community forum post for the full list of new features arriving on your Pixel devices this month.
